newsitem.title: VENEZUELA: Venezuela Fogade sells Latin Corp for $7.52 mln.
newsitem.headline: Venezuela Fogade sells Latin Corp for $7.52 mln.

text.p: Venezuela's State Depostis Guarantee Fund Fogade sold on Friday Colombian financial group Latin Corp to Colombia's Banco Uconal for $7.52 million, Fogade said.

Colombia's Trevia Investments also bid in the public auction for the 84 percent share of Latin Corp bought by Venezuelan banker Orlando Castro in the early 1990s but later taken over by Fogade when Castro's banking interests were hurt by Venezuela's 1994-5 financial crisis.
Uconal president Carlos Dossman said the purchase was a strategic acquisition that would complement Uconal's other activities. Uconal is Colombia's 15th largest bank, Dossman said.
